newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Intan Utilities shares debut at 5.50 rgt.
newsitem.headline: Intan Utilities shares debut at 5.50 rgt.

text.p: Shares of water utility Intan Utilities Bhd made their market debut at 5.50 ringgit against an offer price of 3.30 ringgit.
The company offered 8.08 million new shares for its listing on the main board of the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange.
Intan forecast net profit of 9.59 million ringgit and earnings per share (EPS) of 35.23 cents for the year ended July 31, 1997.
It posted a 8.8 million ringgit net profit on EPS of 40.0 cents in the previous year, on turnover of 39.5 million ringgit.
The company is involved in sourcing, treatment and supply of water within northern Perak state.
Around seven minutes into trading, the stock was at 5.10 ringgit, after trading between 5.0 and 5.60 ringgit. Volume stood at 1.68 million shares.
